Name: Gothic Rose Furniture
Author: YellowSlime233
Description:
荼蘼，死亡，与腐烂

使用的最新版的ff制作，部分家具添加了发光。

壁纸和地板有两种版本:
一种是cp的，壁纸和地板通过CP添加，花瓣小径替换了木头小径（如果跟你的其他替换类型小径美化冲突，可以在配置选项里关掉）

一种是AT的，用油漆桶可以直接更换墙纸和地板以及小径

ff的功能很强大，但因为是第一次用ff制作家具所以很多功能并不熟悉，有些粗糙见谅〈(_ _)〉

欢迎关注我的xhs榴莲牛奶流心牛角包，如果你喜欢我做的美化，可以向我投喂ฅ ˃ ᵕ ˂ ฅ~

2025.07.01
现在上传一个CP版本家具！感谢好心人小红书@mushymato(也是伟大的MMap的作者,[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url]﻿ > v <！)制作！

CP家具文件包含了所有家具,路径,地板和壁纸,也就是说你下载后不用再额外下载壁纸地板文件了（at版本不冲突,可以按需下载）

经过群友测试，CP版本和FF版本有较大的区别:

1.大部分家具把旋转和昼夜拆分单独拆了出来作为一个额外的家具

2.落地灯不再能自主开关

3.部分家具的碰撞体积发生改变（比如露将可以完全穿过，囚笼中间变为实体无法再穿行等等）

如何获得CP版本的家具?
你可以在罗宾那里花费10000购买家具目录,或者使用CJB直接提取所有物品。

注:这个文件必须使用前置MMap才能正常使用
————————————————————————————————————————————
roseleaf raspberry, death, and decay.

The latest version of FF production is used, and some furniture has added lighting.

There are two versions of wallpaper and flooring:

1.One type is CP, where wallpaper and flooring are added through CP, and petal paths replace wooden paths (if it conflicts with your other replacement path beautification types, you can turn it off in the configuration options)

2.One is AT, which can directly replace wallpaper, flooring, and pathways with a paint bucket

The functions of FF are very powerful, but because it is the first time using FF to make furniture, many functions are not familiar, and some are rough. Sorry for the inconvenience〈(_ _)〉

If you like my mod, can you treat me to a cup of coffeeฅ ˃ ᵕ ˂ ฅ~?

2025.07.01

Upload a CP version of furniture now! Thank you to the kind-hearted person Redbook@ mushymato (also the author of the great MMap, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url]>v<!) created this file!

The CP furniture file contains all the furniture, paths, flooring, and wallpapers, which means you don't need to download additional wallpaper and flooring files after downloading (the at version is not conflicting and can be downloaded as needed)

After group testing, there are significant differences between the CP version and the FF version:

1. Most furniture has separated the rotation and day night separation as an additional piece of furniture

2. Floor lamps can no longer be turned on and off independently

3. The collision volume of some furniture has changed (such as dew being able to completely pass through, the middle of the cage becoming solid and unable to pass through, etc.)

How to obtain the CP version of furniture?
You can spend 10000 to purchase a furniture catalog from Robin, or use CJB to directly extract all items.

Note: This file must use a pre MMap to function properly.
